bug_found_and_fixed.summary: Initial render showed infinite recursive <banner> nesting (>120 levels deep) for header/sidebar zones.
bug_found_and_fixed.root_cause: FC_DEFAULT_COMPONENT_MAP mapped componentKeys 'workspace.header'/'workspace.sidebar'/'workspace.content' to surface components that re-instantiated the OUTER <fc-workspace-header-v2> / <fc-workspace-sidebar-v2> / <fc-workspace-content-host-v2> layout. Those V2 layout components themselves iterate zone surfaces and resolve them via DosSurfaceRenderer → infinite mutual recursion.
bug_found_and_fixed.doctrine_resolution: The V2 layout (shell/header/sidebar/content-host) is the ZONE container composed at the SHELL ROOT and iterates inner surfaces. The keys 'workspace.shell|header|sidebar|content' must map to IN-ZONE CONTENT renderers (brand strip / section heading / inert markers reading display text from surface.props in camelCase only) — never to the outer layout.
bug_found_and_fixed.fix: Rewrote products/foundation-console/packages/fc-ui-system/src/surface-components.ts WorkspaceShellSurfaceComponent / WorkspaceHeaderSurfaceComponent / WorkspaceSidebarSurfaceComponent / WorkspaceContentSurfaceComponent to inert content renderers. Removed imports of WorkspaceShellV2Component / WorkspaceHeaderV2Component / WorkspaceSidebarV2Component / WorkspaceContentHostV2Component from surface-components.ts. No DB seed change required; no contract change; no API change.
